purpose: research only; no optimized implementation or speedup measurement
timing_limitations: Shared workstation, n=3 new independent cold CLI invocations; high load, no stable p95/SLA inference. Profiles are CPU-attribution diagnostics, not latency baselines.

sor_count_only.kind: count-only diagnostic; no optimization and no latency claim

steps: Load the derived single-case bundle and effective single-run profile from baseline invocation1.
Prepare the same registry factory and objective, outside the profile. Reuse the recorded case seed.
Open the same quote meter and cProfile(timer=time.process_time) around exactly factory.solve(case,context,budget).
Direct diagnostic calls omit worker IPC/candidate sink and hard worker wall clock; they are not authoritative benchmark latency.
Compare complete evaluation and search statistics with the isolated-run result; all six match.
Count-only SOR wrappers forward unchanged to original functions and record zero-liquidity/uninitialized-step counts; no code or result is optimized.
profile_method.no_parallel_own_jobs: The three CLI runs were sequential; diagnostic processes started after baseline completion and ran sequentially. Other workstation load was not controlled.
